name: Cilica mobile
note: Colour values are copied from docs/design-system/tokens.json and must stay identical. Mobile adds platform role mappings, per-platform type, sizes, radii, springs and haptics.

tokens.name: bg-window
tokens.usage: Opaque window ground. Shows behind the sidebar and assistant only where native vibrancy is unavailable (Linux, Reduce transparency on).

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: The note page and transcript: the content layer. Always opaque, never glass.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Opaque raised surfaces: cards in the note, settings groups, diff cards, inputs on bg-window.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: input fields on bg-canvas, code blocks, the transcript search field.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg-canvas, bg-raised, bg-sunken, bg-window and every glass fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, sidebar rows at rest, assistant tool-step labels. On every bg-* and glass fill.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, counts, kbd hints, section labels. Meets 4.5:1 on bg-canvas, bg-raised and bg-window in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels only (exempt from contrast). Never for information.

tokens.name: fill-press
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected-but-unfocused wash; also the resting fill of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (0.5px on 2x screens, 1px on 1x).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, segmented-control track edge, dragged-item outline. 3:1 is not required: always paired with a fill change.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: In-app floating glass (recorder capsule, toolbars, toasts, Dynamic Island) over backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(180%).

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Glass that carries reading text: menus, command palette, tooltips, popovers.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Outer 0.5px stroke of glass so it separates from bright or busy content.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind the command palette and dialogs, with blur(2px).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Graphite, the only accent: near-black in light, near-white in dark. Primary button fill, active toggle, selection thumb, record-ready glyph. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills: the bg-canvas colour in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text, links, the focus ring and selected icons on bg-canvas, bg-raised, bg-window and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground: active sidebar row, text selection, AI-inserted text in diffs, the selected palette row.

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: Recording red: the live dot, stop control, Dynamic Island while recording. Reserved for recording.

tokens.name: rec-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the recording capsule status chip and the "Recording" row in the sidebar.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (always with a check icon): saved, applied, notes ready.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success chips and accepted diff hunks.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors and removed text in diffs (always with an icon or strike-through).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error banners, danger buttons at rest and removed diff hunks.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (always with a triangle icon): quota near limit, mic muted, low disk.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning banners.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and links inside banners; scheduled-task proposals.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for info banners and the scheduled-review proposal card.

tokens.name: speaker-1
tokens.usage: Speaker colour 1 (blue): avatar ring, name dot and waveform tint for a speaker. A Saved Person keeps the colour they pick. 3:1 on bg-canvas both themes.

tokens.name: speaker-1-soft
tokens.usage: Speaker colour 1 ground: avatar fill behind initials (initials in ink), transcript hover wash for that speaker.

ios.name: largeTitle
ios.usage: Large screen titles (Notes, Meetings), the Home greeting

ios.name: title2
ios.usage: Empty-state headline, sheet titles in large detent

ios.name: headline
ios.usage: Inline bar titles, row titles that need weight, buttons

ios.name: body
ios.usage: Row titles, menus, settings rows, assistant replies

ios.name: subheadline
ios.usage: Row meta and snippet, settings descriptions

ios.name: footnote
ios.usage: Section headers (semibold, ink-3), chips, tool steps

ios.name: caption
ios.usage: Timestamps on cards, footers under grouped lists

android.name: headlineMedium
android.usage: Large screen titles in a LargeTopAppBar, the Home greeting

android.name: bodyLarge
android.usage: Row titles, composer text, assistant replies, settings rows

android.name: bodyMedium
android.usage: Row meta and snippet, settings descriptions

size.note: Points on iOS, dp on Android.

tokens.name: margin-screen
tokens.usage: Side margin on phones (24 on tablets)

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable

tokens.name: row-2line
tokens.usage: Note rows (title + meta)

tokens.name: bar-top
tokens.usage: Top app bar (Android small); iOS nav bar is system-sized

tokens.name: composer-min
tokens.usage: Collapsed composer height (one text line + action row is 104)

tokens.name: send-button
tokens.usage: Round record/send button in the composer

tokens.name: note-measure
tokens.usage: Max note column on tablets

radius.note: Continuous corners everywhere on iOS; smooth corners on Android where available.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips inside cards, tool steps, code blocks

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards inside notes, diff cards, user bubbles' tail-free corners

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Toasts/snackbars, menus (Android), Up next card

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Composer, grouped list sections (iOS), bottom sheets (Android top corners), dialogs

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, search field, recorder bar

motion.note: Same presets as desktop. Compose stiffness = (2π/duration)², dampingRatio = 1 − bounce.
